sentences.zh: 我觉得光是做到这一点就已经很难了。

sentences.en: So, to direct and then be my debut, I'd never directed before, like, that just seemed like not the move.
sentences.zh: 所以，要执导电影，而且还是我的处女作，我以前从没导过戏，这看起来根本不是明智之举。

sentences.en: So, I actually, when I got the producers to—because it was really written for, like, a 21-year-old white Irish Catholic girl,
sentences.zh: 所以，实际上，当我让制片人去——因为剧本原本是为一个21岁的爱尔兰裔白人天主教女孩写的，

sentences.en: and, like, Blake Lively was attached to it at one point.
sentences.zh: 而且，布蕾克·莱弗利一度还曾参与其中。

sentences.en: You were busy?
sentences.zh: 你当时很忙？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Wait, wait, wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等，等等，等等。

sentences.en: Blake Lively was attached initially?
sentences.zh: 布蕾克·莱弗利最初参与过？

sentences.en: Like, that was—and then, wow.
sentences.zh: 就像是——然后，哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, when I got the script, she was attached.
sentences.zh: 是的，我拿到剧本的时候，她还在项目中。

sentences.en: We had the same agent.
sentences.zh: 我们当时是同一个经纪人。

sentences.en: I had just moved to William Morris from CAA, and it was the first script they gave me.
sentences.zh: 我刚从CAA跳槽到威廉·莫里斯，这是他们给我的第一个剧本。

sentences.en: And I was like, thanks, guys, I love this, but it belongs to somebody else.
sentences.zh: 当时我说，谢谢，伙计们，我很喜欢这个故事，但它属于别人。

sentences.en: Yeah, right on.
sentences.zh: 没错，说得对。

sentences.en: That's, like, great agenting, right?
sentences.zh: 那真是太棒的经纪手段了，对吧？

sentences.en: And they said, yeah, but we think, based on our conversations with you, this is something you would really love.
sentences.zh: 他们说，是的，但根据我们与你的谈话，我们认为这是你会真正喜欢的东西。

sentences.en: So, let's just wait and see.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们还是拭目以待吧。

sentences.en: Blake hasn't done it this far.
sentences.zh: 布蕾克到现在还没接。

sentences.en: She may not do it.
sentences.zh: 她可能不会接。

sentences.en: She may.
sentences.zh: 也可能会。

sentences.en: If she does, cool.
sentences.zh: 如果她接了，那也挺好。

sentences.en: But we just want to know, is this the kind of thing you're looking to do?
sentences.zh: 但我们只是想知道，这是否是你想要做的那种事情？

sentences.en: And I said, yeah, it is, and I'm just going to wait.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，确实是，我打算等等看。

sentences.en: And I'm going to hope that she, on her own volition, she passes on this, which she did six months later.
sentences.zh: 我希望她能自愿放弃这个角色，结果六个月后她真的放弃了。

sentences.en: But in that six months, I was reimagining the whole script, the world.
sentences.zh: 但在那六个月里，我一直在重新构思整个剧本和世界观。

sentences.en: I was writing it down, like, how the character would be different being a middle-aged black woman versus a very young 21-year-old white woman, right?
sentences.zh: 我把它写了下来，比如，让一个中年黑人女性来演，而不是一个21岁的年轻白人女性，角色会有什么不同，对吧？

sentences.en: And how important it would be to have a—how—telling a story of a woman having a last chance versus another chance,
sentences.zh: 而且讲述一个女性在“最后一次机会”与“另一次机会”之间的故事，这有多重要，

sentences.en: how much more impactful and meaningful that would be.
sentences.zh: 这会产生多么大的影响和意义。

sentences.en: So, I kept doing my work, and six months later, when she passed, I went to the producer, Basil Iwanek, and I said, hey, I got an idea.
sentences.zh: 所以我继续做我的工作，六个月后，当她放弃时，我去找了制片人巴兹尔·伊万内克，我说，嘿，我有个主意。

sentences.en: It should be me, and here's the story.
sentences.zh: 应该由我来演，故事是这样的。

sentences.en: Here's the world, here's the story, and here's why it's better.
sentences.zh: 这是世界观，这是故事，这是为什么它会更好的原因。

sentences.en: And he said, great, yes, that sounds like a good thing.
sentences.zh: 他说，太棒了，是的，听起来不错。

sentences.en: Now, go find a director.
sentences.zh: 现在，去物色一位导演吧。

sentences.en: And I was like, me find the director?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我去找导演？

sentences.en: He said, yeah, go find the director.
sentences.zh: 他说，没错，去把导演找来。

sentences.en: So, I set out on this journey to find a director.
sentences.zh: 于是，我踏上了寻找导演的旅程。

sentences.en: I met with 12, 13 people, and I met with established directors, first-time directors.
sentences.zh: 我见了十二、十三个人，有资深导演，也有新人导演。

sentences.en: But what I realized is that because this story wasn't on the page yet, it was only in my head, the reimagining of it,
sentences.zh: 但我意识到，因为这个故事还没有写在纸上，只存在于我的脑海里，也就是我重新构思的版本，

sentences.en: that nobody got it like I got it.
sentences.zh: 没有人能像我这样理解它。

sentences.en: Nobody saw it like I saw it.
sentences.zh: 没有人能像我这样看待它。

sentences.en: And I had to come to—I had a come-to-Jesus moment where I realized,
sentences.zh: 我经历了一个顿悟时刻，我意识到，

sentences.en: if this is going to come to fruition the way I see it, I'm going to work harder than I've ever worked physically on anything in my whole career,
sentences.zh: 如果想要按照我设想的方式实现它，我必须付出比我整个职业生涯中任何时候都要艰苦的努力，

sentences.en: I have to make sure it's in the right hands and that this world will be realized in the way that it should be realized.
sentences.zh: 我必须确保它掌握在合适的人手中，并且这个世界能以它应有的方式呈现出来。

sentences.en: You know, it's a new world to see for a movie like this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于这样一部电影来说，这是一个全新的视角。

sentences.en: That's a female point of view.
sentences.zh: 这是一个女性的视角。

sentences.en: It had to be very specific.
sentences.zh: 它必须非常具体。

sentences.en: What's it called?
sentences.zh: 片名叫什么？

sentences.en: It's called Bruised.
sentences.zh: 叫《伤痕累累》。

sentences.en: Oh, Bruised, right, that's right.
sentences.zh: 哦，《伤痕累累》，没错，我想起来了。

sentences.en: And did you do the writing on it, Hallie, the change to it?
sentences.zh: 哈莉，剧本是你写的吗，那些改动？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是我写的。

sentences.en: I worked with the original writer, Michelle Rosenfarb, but we worked very closely together,
sentences.zh: 我和原编剧米歇尔·罗森法布合作，我们配合得非常紧密，

sentences.en: and I totally reimagined the world and the characters and, like, the little boy in the movie used to talk,
sentences.zh: 我彻底重构了那个世界和角色，比如电影里那个小男孩原本是会说话的，

sentences.en: and in my draft, now he's mute.
sentences.zh: 但在我的剧本里，他现在是个哑巴。

sentences.en: Like, there's so many things that we changed about it that made it very unique to this world.
sentences.zh: 我们做了很多改动，让它在这个世界里变得非常独特。

sentences.en: Well, talk to me about the MMA thing.
sentences.zh: 跟我聊聊综合格斗（MMA）的事吧。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: So you had to train for that?
sentences.zh: 所以你必须为此进行训练？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's insane.
sentences.zh: 是啊，那简直疯了。

sentences.en: Like, what was that like?
sentences.zh: 那种感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Do you guys follow MMA at all?
sentences.zh: 你们平时关注综合格斗吗？

sentences.en: Do you follow—
sentences.zh: 你们关注——

sentences.en: Well, no.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有。

sentences.en: I have a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我有一点点。

sentences.en: I mean, these guys know that I boxed.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这些人知道我练过拳击。

sentences.en: I use fight camp.
sentences.zh: 我用的是FightCamp。

sentences.en: Yeah, so they're going to both roll their eyes.
sentences.zh: 是啊，所以他们俩肯定都会翻白眼。

sentences.en: So I boxed.
sentences.zh: 所以我练过拳击。

sentences.en: This will get cut, too.
sentences.zh: 这段也会被剪掉的。

sentences.en: I just—this is not going to get cut.
sentences.zh: 我只是——这段不会被剪掉。

sentences.en: No, we're going to cut this.
sentences.zh: 不，我们要剪掉这段。

sentences.en: We're going to leave with this.
sentences.zh: 我们要保留这段。

sentences.en: No, by the way, I just received my new fight camp yesterday.
sentences.zh: 对了，我昨天刚收到新的FightCamp设备。

sentences.en: The big box came.
sentences.zh: 那个大箱子到了。

sentences.en: Yes—now, do I have to blow that thing up?
sentences.zh: 是啊——现在，我得把那玩意儿充气吗？

sentences.en: No, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: The bag will come later.
sentences.zh: 沙袋晚点才会到。

sentences.en: That's just the base and the trackers and stuff.
sentences.zh: 那只是底座、追踪器之类的东西。

sentences.en: So anyway, so that's hard enough as a couple of middle-aged white guys who are boxing in their basements in Beverly Hills.
sentences.zh: 总之，作为两个在比弗利山庄地下室练拳的中年白人，这已经够难了。

sentences.en: Tell us about actually doing MMA, which is real.
sentences.zh: 跟我们说说真正去练MMA是什么感觉，那可是来真的。

sentences.en: Oh, well, it was hard for a middle-aged black woman, trust me.
sentences.zh: 噢，好吧，对于一个中年黑人女性来说，那真的很难，相信我。

sentences.en: It was—I worked harder than I've ever worked on anything.
sentences.zh: 那是——我付出的努力比我做过的任何事都要多。

sentences.en: I probably trained on it three years ago I started.
sentences.zh: 我大概是三年前开始训练的。

sentences.en: Before I started shooting, I started the training, knowing that this was potentially coming if I could raise the money.
sentences.zh: 在开拍之前，我就开始了训练，因为我知道如果能筹到钱，这事儿可能就会成。

sentences.en: But I was, you know, getting prepared in case I was able to do that.
sentences.zh: 但我当时，你知道，是在做准备，以防我真的能做到。

sentences.en: So—and it was learning, like, jujitsu and taekwondo, muay thai, wrestling, kickboxing.
sentences.zh: 所以——那是学习柔术、跆拳道、泰拳、摔跤和踢拳。

sentences.en: You know, all these disciplines that I—I knew a little bit of capoeira from Catwoman, but—
sentences.zh: 你知道，所有这些项目，我——我从《猫女》时期了解一点卡波耶拉，但是——

sentences.en: You hurt anything?
sentences.zh: 你受伤了吗？

sentences.en: Break anything?
sentences.zh: 骨折了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, did you get—did you get hit in the face accidentally more often than you accidentally hit somebody in the face?
sentences.zh: 是啊，你是不是比你不小心打到别人脸，更多地被别人不小心打到脸？

sentences.en: Which is a higher number?
sentences.zh: 哪个次数更多？

sentences.en: I got hit more.
sentences.zh: 我被打到的次数更多。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: When you get hit in the nose, it really hurts.
sentences.zh: 当你鼻子被打到时，真的很疼。

sentences.en: It really does.
sentences.zh: 确实很疼。

sentences.en: It really does.
sentences.zh: 真的非常疼。

sentences.en: What did you break?
sentences.zh: 你哪里骨折了？

sentences.en: I broke—I broke—well, I broke two toes in training.
sentences.zh: 我骨折了——我骨折了——好吧，我在训练中折了两根脚趾。

sentences.en: I dislocated a finger.
sentences.zh: 我脱臼了一根手指。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And I—day two of shooting, you know, we did the fight first because we were—Valentina Shevchenko, she plays my opponent.
sentences.zh: 而且我——拍摄的第二天，你知道，我们先拍了打斗戏，因为我们——瓦伦蒂娜·舍甫琴科，她饰演我的对手。

sentences.en: She's the UFC flyweight champion of the world right now.
sentences.zh: 她现在是UFC蝇量级世界冠军。

sentences.en: And she was my opponent.
sentences.zh: 她就是我的对手。

sentences.en: So we trained within an inch of our life for, like, two months, heavy, like, five, six hours a day before we actually started to shoot.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在正式开拍前，像玩命一样训练了大概两个月，强度很大，每天五六个小时。

sentences.en: And I shot my fight first because we were ready and it was in our minds, our choreo and everything.
sentences.zh: 我先拍了我的打斗戏，因为我们准备好了，而且动作编排什么的都在脑子里。

sentences.en: Day two of a five-day fight, I broke two ribs.
sentences.zh: 在五天打斗戏拍摄的第二天，我断了两根肋骨。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: And I know, and I knew they were broken, but I also knew that if I told anybody, they would shut me down.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我知道它们断了，但我也知道如果我告诉任何人，他们就会叫停拍摄。

sentences.en: Right, of course.
sentences.zh: 没错，当然。

sentences.en: So—
sentences.zh: 所以——

sentences.en: It's hard to breathe and everything.
sentences.zh: 呼吸什么的都很困难。

sentences.en: You're like a professional athlete.
sentences.zh: 你就像个职业运动员一样。

sentences.en: You're like, no, I've got to stay on the field, coach.
sentences.zh: 你心里想的是，不，教练，我得留在场上。

sentences.en: That's kind of how I felt.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: And these fighters that talk to me about when they get injured in the cage, in the ring, like, there is no stopping unless the referee or somebody stops it.
sentences.zh: 那些格斗选手跟我聊起他们在笼子里、在拳台上受伤的时候，他们说除非裁判或其他人叫停，否则根本停不下来。

sentences.en: But their mindset is to just keep going.
sentences.zh: 但他们的心态就是坚持到底。

sentences.en: You've trained so hard to get to this moment.
sentences.zh: 你为了这一刻付出了那么艰苦的训练。

sentences.en: Like, you just aren't going to bail out.
sentences.zh: 所以，你根本不会选择放弃。

sentences.en: And that's very much how I felt.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: At the end of that second day, I went to one of my producers and I said, you know, I know I broke two ribs, but I don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 第二天结束时，我找到其中一位制片人说，我知道我断了两根肋骨，但我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: I can't stop.
sentences.zh: 我不能停。

sentences.en: And, you know, he said to me, well, you don't want to puncture a lung, though.
sentences.zh: 他当时对我说，但你总不想把肺刺穿吧。

sentences.en: I mean, this is kind of dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太危险了。

sentences.en: And I said, I know, but I've come too far.
sentences.zh: 我说，我知道，但我已经走了这么远了。

sentences.en: I've worked too hard.
sentences.zh: 我付出了太多努力。

sentences.en: Like, this might all go away and never come back.
sentences.zh: 如果现在放弃，这一切可能就全完了，再也回不来了。

sentences.en: And so how did you work around that?
sentences.zh: 那你后来是怎么解决的呢？

sentences.en: How did you get the other three days shot?
sentences.zh: 剩下的三天你是怎么拍完的？

sentences.en: Took a lot of Advil.
sentences.zh: 吃了好多布洛芬。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And just prayed that I wouldn't severely injure myself.
sentences.zh: 只能祈祷自己不会受更严重的伤。

sentences.en: Sean, you threw your shoulder.
sentences.zh: 肖恩，你把肩膀弄脱臼了。

sentences.en: Did you dislocate your shoulder?
sentences.zh: 你是肩膀脱臼了吗？

sentences.en: One time, Sean told me they went to Gelson's.
sentences.zh: 有一次，肖恩跟我说他们去了Gelson's超市。

sentences.en: They switched.
sentences.zh: 他们换了货架位置。

sentences.en: They put the vanilla wafers on the Topshop.
sentences.zh: 他们把香草威化饼干放到了最顶层。

sentences.en: And he ended up, and he had to reach to get those, you know, vanilla wafers.
sentences.zh: 他最后为了拿到那些香草威化饼干，不得不伸手去够。

sentences.en: Nilla.
sentences.zh: 尼拉威化。

sentences.en: And they moved it.
sentences.zh: 他们把位置挪了。

sentences.en: And Scotty said, don't do it.
sentences.zh: 斯科蒂说，别去拿了。

sentences.en: And he knew, if I tell Scotty that I dislocated my shoulder, he'll say, just get the graham crackers instead.
sentences.zh: 他心里清楚，如果告诉斯科蒂自己肩膀脱臼了，他肯定会说，换成全麦饼干算了。

sentences.en: And he was like, but I'm going to get those Nilla wafers.
sentences.zh: 但他当时想的是，不行，我一定要拿到那些尼拉威化饼干。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I said, I'm out.
sentences.zh: 我说，我不干了。

sentences.en: For those reasons, I'm out.
sentences.zh: 基于这些原因，我退出了。

sentences.en: I can't.
sentences.zh: 我做不到。

sentences.en: I got to say, that's super admirable.
sentences.zh: 我得说，这真的非常令人钦佩。

sentences.en: Hallie, did you find, so it's all this, like, incredible physical training.
sentences.zh: 哈莉，你有没有发现，虽然这全是那种不可思议的体能训练。

sentences.en: But did you get that kind of, did you start to get, like, the byproduct of it, the happy byproduct being that you got a lot of, like, mental calmness from it?
sentences.zh: 但你有没有从中获得那种，或者说你开始获得那种副产品，即那种快乐的副产品，让你从中获得了内心的平静？

sentences.en: Did you find it at all sort of meditative once you started training a lot and getting into that zone in any way?
sentences.zh: 当你开始大量训练并进入那种状态时，你有没有觉得这在某种程度上是一种冥想？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: You know, so much of the fight game is all mental preparation.
sentences.zh: 你知道，格斗比赛很大程度上都是心理准备。

sentences.en: I think people focus on, you know, the chokes and the knockouts and all of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们只关注锁喉、击倒之类的东西。

sentences.en: But really, it's a mental game.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这是一场心理博弈。

sentences.en: And my mental game did get strengthened.
sentences.zh: 我的心理素质确实得到了加强。

sentences.en: And it's so strong that I think that's the only reason I made it through this film.
sentences.zh: 而且它变得如此强大，我觉得这也是我能拍完这部电影的唯一原因。

sentences.en: Because there was one catastrophe after another when you're trying to make, I mean, getting any movie made today, you know, it's not easy.
sentences.zh: 因为在制作过程中，灾难接二连三地发生，我是说，如今想要拍成任何一部电影都不容易。

sentences.en: But an independent, low-budget film and the way in which we were making it, we were losing money left and right.
sentences.zh: 更何况是一部低成本的独立电影，而且以我们当时那种制作方式，我们一直在亏钱。

sentences.en: That mental fortitude that came from those three years of training and what I learned, definitely, I'll have that with me for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 那三年训练带来的心理韧性，以及我所学到的东西，绝对会伴随我一生。

sentences.en: And I'll keep training.
sentences.zh: 我会继续训练。

sentences.en: What about the directing part?
